prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: isolated final compositing layer for a scroll-driven PC assembly on a gaming-club website
Input images: Image 1 is the exact assembled-PC reference and defines camera, perspective, lighting, scale and the side-panel placement. Image 2 is a secondary material reference for tempered glass, edge finish and mounting hardware.
Primary request: generate ONLY the transparent smoked tempered-glass left side panel of the PC tower as it appears installed in Image 1, including its slim polished edges, four small black mounting screws, realistic subtle diagonal studio reflection and faint warm-yellow rim highlights. No chassis, no internals and no other PC parts.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat, uniform chroma magenta #FF00FF covering every background pixel and visible cleanly through the transparent glass.
Style/medium: high-end photorealistic studio product photography, physically plausible transparent glass and reflections.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5 canvas matching Image 1 exactly. The panel must already occupy the exact installed side-panel coordinates, scale and three-quarter perspective of Image 1, forming the left-facing quadrilateral of the future tower. Keep the full panel inside frame; all area outside it remains magenta.
Lighting/mood: same low-key black studio lighting as Image 1; controlled diagonal softbox reflection; no cast shadow or floor reflection.
Materials/textures: smoked safety glass with real transparency, subtle thickness and polished edges; realistic metal fasteners; reflections restrained enough that assembled components remain visible beneath it.
Constraints: exact solid #FF00FF outside and clearly visible through transparent regions; only the glass panel and its mounting fasteners; no opaque black fill behind glass; no external/drop shadow; no text; no logo; no watermark; no frame, case, motherboard, GPU, fans, cables or cooler.
Avoid: freestanding catalog panel, front-on rectangle, mirror-like opaque surface, frosted glass, black background, cartoon, CGI illustration look, rainbow RGB, cyan or purple lights.
